question: Are cards exiled with suspend exiled face up?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: cards exiled with suspend are exiled face up.
expected.answer: Cards exiled with suspend are exiled face up.

whyHard: Suspended cards waiting in exile feel hidden, so players assume they are face down.
